# OMP NInfer

> Durable local inference for coding agents: the qualified local inference appliance for
> Oh My Pi. Your coding session should survive the process. Oh My Pi (coding-agent client) →
> OMP NInfer (qualified appliance and release layer) → NInfer (inference engine) → Qwen3.8 27B
> (served model). Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Oh My Pi, Qwen, or
> NVIDIA.

Qualified on RTX 5090 · 4090 · 3090 — **v0.13.0** (published 2026-10-25, GitHub Latest), stock
**Oh My Pi 18.12.6** (`45c35e40`).
- **RTX 5090 container lane:** Windows 11 + Docker Desktop/WSL2 on loopback `127.0.0.1:18089`
  (local Windows client or manual macOS SSH tunnel preview); `v0.7.0-qwen38-5090-beta.2` (source
  `6d4d0a05` on upstream master `64d10fbf`, image `5d10a998`), profile `qwen38-5090-v0.13.0`
  (`751d22dc`), model container v3 `81f924d4` (20.4 GB), DFlash2 draft window 7, BF16 KV (146,368
  automatic tokens), 131,072-token context, two requests in flight, schema 3 checkpoints
  (`checkpoints-v013`, strict origin auth, non-blocking export), JSON-schema output, 128-character
  tool names, vision + tools.
- **RTX 4090 and RTX 3090 native Windows 11 lanes:** `v0.6.11-qwen38-4090-beta.1` and
  `v0.6.3-qwen38-3090-beta.1` on loopback `127.0.0.1:18082`, UUID-bound on one two-GPU host
  (sequential single-GPU serving, one lane at a time), model `eec39564` (18.2 GB), MTP3, INT8 KV,
  131,072-token context, one request at a time, text + tools (no vision); carried unchanged from
  v0.12.2 while rebased native packages target v0.13.1.
- **Proof:** Fresh v0.13.0 acceptance on frozen candidate `b1a54dc9` across five documented routes
  (31 steps), three stock Oh My Pi 18.12.6 clients (macOS arm64 preview, Windows x64, Linux x64
  under WSL2), and both native Windows public installs (owner-operated, 403.372 s RTX 5090 hold);
  RTX 5090 runtime qualification is fresh on `6d4d0a05` (179.86 tok/s server decode, 56.994 s cold
  exact 130,048-token retrieval) and native runtime qualifications carry from v0.12.0/v0.12.2.

## Release authorities (v0.13.0)

- [v0.13.0 manifest](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.13.0/releases/v0.13.0/manifest.json): exact client, runtime, model, and profile pins
- [v0.13.0 release notes](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.13.0/releases/v0.13.0/NINFER_RELEASE_NOTES.md): release scope, client SHA-256 digests, acceptance, and support boundaries
- [v0.13.0 tagged quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.13.0/docs/QUICKSTART.md): immutable installation guide for v0.13.0

## Living canonical documents

- [Canonical facts](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/FACTS.md): entity relationship, fit, lane table, models, durability, and checkpoint transport

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): lane selection, prerequisites, and executable installation routes
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): generated matrix of qualified client and runtime combinations
- [Architecture](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): state ownership, loopback topology, checkpoint replication, and identity chain
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md): methodology, per-lane qualification numbers, and historical receipts
- [Security](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): trust boundary, loopback invariants, key handling, and verification
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): failure signatures, recovery, and safe reporting
- [Media provenance](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/media/README.md): recording provenance, hashes, and historical demo scope
